hero.eyebrow: Video courses and live classes for independent educators
hero.body: Zeno is a whole school in one place: lessons that stream protected from piracy, students who pay the way they already pay, and every sale accounted for to the last decimal.

record.title: Record
record.hint: Upload from the browser, in parts that survive a dropped connection.

protect.title: Protect
protect.hint: Encrypted video, with keys only for students who paid.

sell.title: Sell
sell.hint: Checkout, coupons, invoices and refunds, built in.

paid.title: Paid
paid.hint: Every sale in a ledger, paid out to your bank.

pipeline.label: How it works
pipeline.title: From your camera to a student anywhere.
pipeline.guide: Scroll, and I will show you what happens to a lesson.

upload.title: Upload
upload.body: Straight from the browser, in parts. If the Wi-Fi drops halfway, the parts already sent stay sent.

transcode.title: Transcode
transcode.body: One file becomes five qualities, so a slow connection gets a smooth picture instead of a spinner.

protect.title: Protect
protect.body: Every few seconds of video is encrypted on its own. The key goes only to a student who paid, on at most three devices.

deliver.title: Deliver
deliver.body: Served from the edge nearest each student, wherever in the world they happen to be.

money.label: Payments
money.title: Every sale, accounted for.
money.body: Each payment is written into a double-entry ledger in the same moment the student gets access. Refunds, fees and payouts land in the same book, so the number you see is the number you get.
money.guide: That bottom line is yours. I checked the arithmetic.
money.methods: Cards, UPI, wallets and bank transfers, through the payment provider your students already trust.

receipt.title: Receipt
receipt.note: Payment fees vary by country and method; this example uses a typical card rate.

live.label: Live
live.title: Go live. Keep the recording.
live.body: Teach a class live and answer questions as they arrive. When you end it, the recording becomes the next lesson in your course, already protected.

students.label: Students
students.title: Made for the phone in their pocket.
students.body: The picture adapts to the connection, playback picks up where they stopped, and there is nothing to install.

close.title:
Your lessons. Your students.

Your income.
close.body: Zeno is in private beta with a small group of educators. Bring your first course.

footer.tagline: Video courses and live classes for independent educators.
footer.made: Made with care, for teachers everywhere.
